purpose: Close the cross-organization wagon authorization gap found by the independent review of #5044: RailwayService.updateWagonStatus and createGU12 looked a wagon up by id only, so a LOGISTICIAN or ADMIN of any organization could move another organization's wagon to MAINTENANCE or put another organization's FREE wagon into its own GU-12 request (which, once approved, set that wagon ASSIGNED with a foreign currentDealId). Both paths now require the wagon to belong to the caller's session organization; a foreign wagon is reported exactly like a missing one.
requiredInvariants: The caller organization comes only from the authenticated session (CurrentUser.orgId), never from the request body, query or path.
A wagon of another organization is indistinguishable from a missing wagon: same NotFoundException and message.
A GU-12 request containing any wagon not owned by the requestor is rejected as a whole and nothing is stored.
No role bypass: ADMIN is an organization membership role here, not platform staff.
No DTO, validation boundary, baseline, register, workflow, dependency or lockfile change.
acceptance: cd apps/api && npx jest src/modules/railway: 2 suites, 36 tests pass.
Mutation: removing the ownerOrgId comparison fails 6 of the 9 new ownership tests.
